SELECT s.id, s.name, s.phone, s.logo_url, s.merchant_id, s.business_hours, s.business_status, s.is_enable AS enable, CONCAT(s.location, s.address_detail) AS addressDetail, m.id AS merchantId, m.name AS merchantName, m.logo_url AS merchantLogo
FROM stores AS s JOIN merchants AS m ON s.merchant_id = m.id
WHERE s.is_deleted = 0 AND m.is_deleted = 0
AND s.merchant_id = CAST(#{dto.merchantId} AS BIGINT)
AND s.is_enable = ${dto.enable ? 1 : 0}
AND s.name LIKE CONCAT(#{dto.keyword}, '%')
AND s.business_status IN
#{status}
ORDER BY s.created_time DESC, s.is_enable

SELECT s.id AS storeId, m.id AS merchantId, i.id AS industryId
FROM stores AS s JOIN merchants AS m ON s.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN industries AS i ON s.industry_id = i.id
AND s.industry_id = #{industryId}
AND JSON_CONTAINS(s.region_code, CAST(#{regionCode} AS JSON), '$')
AND i.is_deleted = 0 AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.is_enable = 1

SELECT id, name, logo_url, industry_id, merchant_id, business_hours, business_status, address_detail AS address, ST_DISTANCE_SPHERE(POINT(longitude, latitude), POINT(#{dto.longitude}, #{dto.latitude})) AS distance
FROM stores AS s
ORDER BY distance

SELECT s.id, s.name, s.phone, s.logo_url, s.latitude, s.longitude, s.description, s.industry_id, s.merchant_id, s.store_score, s.business_hours, s.business_status, i.name AS industryName, m.name AS merchantName, m.logo_url AS merchantLogo, CONCAT(s.location, s.address_detail) AS addressDetail, ST_DISTANCE_SPHERE(POINT(s.longitude, s.latitude), POINT(#{dto.longitude}, #{dto.latitude})) / 1000 AS distance
FROM stores AS s JOIN merchants AS m ON s.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN industries AS i ON s.industry_id = i.id
AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.is_enable = 1 AND i.is_deleted = 0 AND i.is_enable = 1
ORDER BY distance

SELECT
images
JSON_EXTRACT(images, '$[0 to 9]')
FROM stores WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND id = #{storeId}
SELECT id, license_no, license_images AS licenseImage FROM stores WHERE id = #{storeId} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT id AS storeId, name AS storeName, logo_url AS storeLogo, address_detail AS storeAddress, phone AS contactPhone, business_hours, business_status, store_score, latitude, longitude,
ST_DISTANCE_SPHERE(POINT(longitude, latitude), POINT(#{longitude}, #{latitude})) / 1000 AS distance
FROM stores WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND business_status NOT IN ('CLOSED', 'DELETED')
ORDER BY distance

SELECT s.id AS storeId, s.name AS storeName, s.logo_url AS storeLogo, s.phone AS storePhone, s.description, s.business_hours, s.business_status, s.store_score, s.latitude, s.longitude, s.merchant_id, m.name AS merchantName, m.logo_url AS merchantLogo, s.industry_id, i.name AS industryName, JSON_EXTRACT(s.images, '$[0 to 9]') AS images, CONCAT(s.location, s.address_detail) AS storeAddress,
, ST_DISTANCE_SPHERE(POINT(longitude, latitude), POINT(#{longitude}, #{latitude})) / 1000 AS distance
FROM stores AS s JOIN merchants AS m ON s.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN industries AS i ON s.industry_id = i.id
WHERE s.id = #{storeId} AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.is_enable = 1 AND s.business_status NOT IN ('CLOSED', 'DELETED') AND m.business_status = 'OPERATING' AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.is_enable = 1 AND i.is_deleted = 0 AND i.is_enable = 1

SELECT s.id, s.name, s.phone, s.description, CONCAT(s.location, s.address_detail) AS addressDetail, s.logo_url, s.business_hours, s.business_status, s.store_score, s.latitude, s.longitude, s.merchant_id, m.name AS merchantName, m.logo_url AS merchantLogo, s.industry_id, i.name AS industryName
FROM stores AS s JOIN merchants AS m ON s.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN industries AS i ON s.industry_id = i.id
WHERE s.is_enable = 1 AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.business_status NOT IN ('CLOSED', 'DELETED') AND m.business_status = 'OPERATING' AND m.is_enable = 1 AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND i.is_enable = 1 AND i.is_deleted = 0
LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{current}
FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM stores WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND id = #{storeId}

SELECT s.id, s.name, s.phone, s.logo_url, s.business_hours, s.business_status, s.is_enable AS enable, CONCAT(s.location, s.address_detail) AS addressDetail, m.id AS merchantId, m.name AS merchantName, m.logo_url AS merchantLogo
FROM stores AS s JOIN merchants AS m ON s.merchant_id = m.id JOIN industries AS i ON s.industry_id = i.id
WHERE s.is_deleted = 0 AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND i.is_deleted = 0 -- 门店name右模糊匹配
AND s.name LIKE CONCAT(#{dto.name}, '%')
-- 商家id匹配
AND s.merchant_id IN
CAST(#{mid} AS BIGINT)
-- 行业id匹配
AND s.industry_id IN
CAST(#{iid} AS BIGINT)
-- 门店region_code匹配
AND JSON_OVERLAPS(s.region_code -> '$[*]', CAST(#{dto.regionJson} AS JSON))
-- 门店business_status匹配
AND s.business_status IN
#{status}
-- 门店is_enable状态匹配
AND s.is_enable = CASE WHEN #{dto.enable} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
ORDER BY s.is_enable DESC, s.created_time DESC
